research_scope: Direct-source follow-up on five canonical null race_restriction CaC-usable skills.

records.name: Ki Blast Cannon
records.evidence: Prior repository research classifies Ki Blast Cannon as a Ki Blast Super usable by the Future Warrior/CaC. Reviewed skill references do not state a narrower CaC race/gender/form condition. Character users and generic CaC availability are not sufficient to populate a restriction.

records.name: Life Absorbtion
records.evidence: The canonical record remains CaC-usable. Reviewed repository evidence does not establish explicit CaC race/gender/form eligibility wording; therefore no race restriction is inferred.

records.name: Miracle Kneel
records.evidence: Current/recovered skill evidence establishes Miracle Kneel as a CaC-usable Evasive, but no explicit retail race/gender/form restriction was found. Skill category and acquisition context do not establish a race restriction.

records.name: Peeler Storm
records.evidence: Prior direct research identifies Peeler Storm as a Future Warrior/CaC-usable skill. Reviewed references provide no explicit narrower CaC race/gender/form restriction, so null is retained.

records.name: Power Pole
records.evidence: Current technique references establish Power Pole as a Future Warrior-usable skill, but no explicit CaC race/gender/form restriction is stated. Weapon/technique identity is not race eligibility evidence.

policy: Only explicit CaC eligibility wording establishing a narrower race/gender/form condition can populate race_restriction; preserve null otherwise.
